title: hear.ingest.v1
description: Canonical DAMA Hear ingest envelope, major version 1. Normative wire codec is UTF-8 JSON (application/vnd.dama.hear.ingest.v1+json). Readers MUST accept unknown properties and unknown enum members within this major and MUST refuse an unsupported schema_version with a durable refusal record. event_id is derived only from source, device_id, kind, observed_at, producer.boot_id, producer.sequence, producer.cursor, payload.

event_id.description: Stable content-derived UUID. See derive_event_id(); identity inputs are closed.

source.description: Ingress family that produced this envelope, not the transport endpoint.

site_id.description: Site token. Derived from the credential; never trusted from an untrusted body.

device_id.description: Node or producer identity as enrolled.

device_class.description: Board or producer class, e.g. esp32s3-i2s-gps.

observed_at.description: RFC3339 UTC instant of observation, or null when the producer had no usable clock.

received_at.description: RFC3339 UTC instant the adapter accepted the bytes. Never a producer claim.

valid.description: False means observed_at is not usable for precise localization.

tier.description: Timebase class. wall/monotonic are never treated as PPS time.

kind.description: Record family. An unknown member is preserved but not dispatchable.

schema_version.description: Envelope major version. Unsupported majors are refused, not coerced.

payload.description: Kind-specific body. Binary frames travel here base64-encoded with their own version/profile fields; the envelope never reinterprets them.

raw_ref.description: Object-store key of the retained original bytes, or null when inlined.

adapter.description: Translating adapter identity, so a bad translation is attributable.

boot_id.description: Producer boot identity; a change means cursors are not comparable.

boot_epoch_us.description: Producer boot epoch in microseconds UTC.

cursor.description: Opaque source partition/cursor token the record was read at.

producer.description: Optional producer continuity evidence. Additive in v1: absent means the producer exposes no boot/sequence/cursor, not that continuity is fine.
